label: Update gate dips when state S1 is shown at D2, most late in episode.
short_terms: (phase == D2) * (state == S1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * (ep_dec == 9) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * (prev_action == 1)
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == S1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * (ep_dec == 9) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (ep_dec==9)*((tv("reward",-1)==0)*1+(tv("reward",-2)==0)+(tv("reward",-3)==0)) ;; (phase==D2)*(common==0)*(ep_dec==9) ;; (phase==GO)*(prev_state==S1) ;; (ep_dec==9)*(phase==D2)*(action==2)
explanation: Raw z of unit 30 sits near 1 and mostly follows timing (a steep drop over the last episode decade, strongest at D2; timing R^2 0.63). Beyond timing it is lowered at D2 when the reached state is S1 (regardless of choice; strongly amplified in trials 90-99, e.g. a2->S1 rare at t95-99 drops z to ~0.7), and at D1 after an a1->S2 rare trial. Short form test 0.15 vs free fit 0.20, against an additive ceiling of 0.21, so it captures most of what is capturable but little of the total residual. The free fit adds a late-episode drop with recent unrewarded trials, a small GO effect after S1, and late rare-transition/choice terms. Belief, hidden good state and future reward add almost nothing.
